evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Analyse de cohérence des données et mise en place de monitoring
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Audits, data consistency checks, monitoring and careful documentation ("vous documentez minutieusement votre travail") outweigh the deadline and responsiveness language, which is about service rather than shipping speed.
evidence.domain_risk: Plus d'une centaine d'entreprise nous font déjà confiance pour leurs enjeux Data & AI les plus exigeants, parmi lesquelles Auchan, EDF ou encore LVMH.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Consulting work on clients' analytics platforms affects business decisions without financial or regulatory reporting language, so it is moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Construction / Evolution de pipeline Data complexes
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role builds and extends client platforms inside an established practice with an internal lab, so the context is a working data function rather than a first hire or a large specialised org.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets name concrete deliverables (CDP deployment, FinOps, DAT documentation, TMA, CI/CD), so the day-to-day work is clear.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: vous accompagnez plusieurs clients dans leurs enjeux Analytics et Data cloud
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The work splits between clients' data platforms and business development ("Détection proactive des nouveaux besoins chez les clients").
evidence.autonomy_level: Planification : Construction de roadmap personnalisées et priorisation des sujets
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role scopes client needs, builds roadmaps and leads projects autonomously ("Gestion de projet autonome").
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI tools appear only as something the firm trains staff on ("Nous encourageons et formons nos collaborateurs à l‘utilisation de plusieurs services d'Intelligence artificiel"), not as an expected candidate skill.
evidence.testing_framing: Analyse de cohérence des données et mise en place de monitoring
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Setting up data consistency analysis and monitoring is a named responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: garant de la qualité de service Optimize matter (Réactivité, respect des délais, documentations …)
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Monitoring and service quality matter, but the posting is framed around delivery and advisory, with no compliance or trust register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Construction / Evolution d'architectures techniques cloud (GCP /AWS/ AZure)
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: New platform builds sit alongside evolving existing pipelines ("intervenir sur des pipeline de données complexes déjà existants").
evidence.language_gate: Très bon niveau en Français et en Anglais
evidence.loss_aversion: Analyse de cohérence des données et mise en place de monitoring — data consistency is one delivery task among many, not the framing of the role.
